content: Does Mathlib not have anything about line bundles in Algebraic Geometry. I found a class called SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFree but this is more than just vector bundles. Is there some standard way to dealing with line bundles - considering these are fundamental object (which I feel should have come up somewhere in some proof in Mathlib).
#42860 (monoidal structure on SheafOfModules) works towards the definition stacks#0B8K (2) that works over ringed spaces.
Ah, okay. Any clue why your PR hasn't been merged in over a month?
Ah, I see that it depends on anther PR
#44200 defines the Picard group as well as showing that an O_X module is locally free of rank 1 iff it is invertible. I would expect it to be a long time before it is merged however.
(I guess it would not be merged in this form because it's too long to review?)
